title: Casper and the Ledger
author: Rosalind Okafor
blurb: Rafael Marchetti, a widowed lighthouse keeper during the year of the great storms, believes history happens to other people, elsewhere. Then the army requisitions the town and the ledger with all the names — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must finish the work while the workshop still stands before the ship sails on the morning tide.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
